launch_scene_viewer: launch a scene viewer using servez to visualize Minecraft voxel scenes from a scene list dictionary
run_scene_viewer_main: run the scene viewer script to generate example Minecraft scenes and launch the browser-based viewer
review_launch_scene_viewer: review the launch_scene_viewer function to understand how it validates scene data and serves files via servez
refactor_scene_validation: refactor the launch_scene_viewer function to support additional EXPECTED_KEYS for scene validation
summarize_scene_viewer: summarize the view_scene module which launches a browser-based viewer for Minecraft voxel scene visualization
